messages:
Mike A.: Quick handoff for Orbit (Helios Labs) — closing notes from AE side. They signed yesterday (PO emailed), plan: private deploy in GCP, SSO via SAML, dedicated capacity requested for initial pilot. Renewal window ~9 months. Main risks: SSO attribute mapping unknown, infra quota for GPUs, and unclear eval metrics from their data team.

Sarah C.: Thanks Mike. Can you confirm the primary contact from customer side and the desired go-live target? Also any known legal/security checklist items?

Mike A.: Primary: alex@helioslabs.com (Director of ML infra). GO-LIVE target: pilot by 2024-09-20 (internal). Legal: standard DPA done, but they requested a private audit window and HSM/KMS integration notes.

Leila O.: Adding onboarding checklist items I care about: SSO test account, VPC peering details, expected QPS for pilot, sample prompt set + eval criteria. Can we get an initial runbook link?

Mike A.: Putting links — runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/helios-orbit (you'll need SSO access). Pilot QPS estimate: 50 req/s peak, expected average 10. They want latency < 300ms p95 for short-chat flows.

Priya R.: Thanks. From SE side, we should confirm model / quantization plan and autoscale policy. If they need <300ms p95, dedicated small cluster with batching disabled for chat may be required. I'll propose configs.

Jordan S.: Support take: we'll own post-deploy incidents and SSO mapping tickets. Can Jordan@support get the SAML metadata and example attributes? We'll open an internal ticket once those are in.

Mike A.: @Jordan S. sending metadata now — attaching SAML metadata XML and their attribute list in the email thread. Also they flagged a legal ask about log retention (want 90-day logs).

Sarah C.: Owner map: Sarah C. -> overall CS lead, Leila O. -> onboarding runbook/coordination, Priya R. -> SE/perform tuning, Jordan S. -> support/triage. I'll schedule a kickoff for Monday 2024-06-10 10:00 PT. Does that work?

Leila O.: Works for me. Agenda I'll own: 1) provisioning timeline, 2) SSO test plan, 3) telemetry + eval metrics, 4) access/owners. Can someone from infra confirm GPU quota by EOD Friday?

ops-bot: infra-quotas-check report: project-redwood-prod has 2/10 GPUs available in us-west1. If you need more, please file quota request with tag #infra-urgent.

Priya R.: Noted — I'll request burst capacity for pilot. Also I'll draft a minimal eval harness to capture token-level latency and correctness on their prompt set.

Jordan S.: Once we have SAML metadata + sample user, I'll run attribute mapping in staging and post the mapping checklist here.

Mike A.: Capture action items: (A) Alex to send SAML metadata + sample user (owner: Alex/Helios) (B) Infra quota decision / request (owner: Priya/Infra) (C) Kickoff Monday 6/10 10am PT (owner: Sarah) (D) Onboarding runbook finalization (owner: Leila) (E) Retention/KMS notes to legal (owner: Mike).

Sarah C.: I'll create a shared Confluence page and link to the runbook + meeting notes. Also adding a renewal watch: set reminder at 6 months pre-renewal to flag risk if pilot metrics not hit.

Leila O.: Quick ask — how do we want to capture early feedback from their ML team? I propose a short weekly checklist: stability, latency, inference cost estimate, and one open feedback item. We can capture in the confluence page + biweekly sync.

Priya R.: Agree. I'll surface a cost projection for two configs (dedicated + burst vs burst-only) for the meeting.

Jordan S.: FYI I'm going to create internal support ticket -> HEL-1022 with initial SSO step list and link it here when done.

Mike A.: Sounds good. One more note: they have an internal eval where they will compare latency/cost vs another provider in 8 weeks. It's a potential renewal risk if early numbers don't look competitive. Suggest we prioritize latency telemetry in first week post-deploy.

Sarah C.: Agreed — Priya, can you include a short telemetry dashboard (p95, cost/token, errors) for day-1?

Priya R.: Yep. I’ll scope a lightweight dashboard and attach sample queries in the runbook. Example query snippet:

```sql
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95, AVG(cost_per_token)
FROM inference_logs
WHERE customer = 'helios' AND time > now() - interval '1 day';
```

Leila O.: Good. I'll add the weekly feedback checklist template to Confluence before kickoff.

Mike A.: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with Alex for the SAML metadata and ping here once I have it. :thumbsup:

Sarah C.: Closing note: owners + due dates on Confluence, we'll use the kickoff to confirm access and SSO test window. See you Monday. :calendar:
